jobs_results.description:
About Miravia :

Miravia is a cutting-edge e-commerce platform connecting buyers and sellers seamlessly. We pride ourselves on offering a diverse and dynamic shopping experience by bringing on board innovative brands across various categories. Located in Madrid, we work with teams from all over the world to build the e-commerce platforms of tomorrow.

Requirements:

- Have FE knowledge PHP, HTML, CSS, Javascript, etc, like to read and understand the souce code

- Have Knowledge of PHP、ReactJS、VueJS / AngularJS framework, like to understand the theory

- Like to explore and solve different kinds of problem, high efficient on work delivery

- Have ability to work as a team member, good communication with people from different team and a good English Level.

- Experience in Prestashop, Shopify and some other famous Web Builder and module development is a plus.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor / Master degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject

• Experience in coding best... practices

• Knowledge of software engineering processes and tools

• Good English communication skills.

• Experience working in an international environment is a plus

If you think you are the perfect match to this role, please send us your CV, we would like know more about you!

Please send us your CV in English

jobs_results.title: Front-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
Insight

If you want to join in a diverse team, where everyone has a voice and works as part of a team. Moreover, you have experience as a Front-end Developer with a background building elegant, performant, and maintainable front-end systems, then you are in the right place!

How will you make an impact?
• Supporting component design, development, maintenance and taking responsibility for personal technical quality standards within the project team.
• Assisting with structured practices definitions, especially in source code management, building, and deployment.
• Building highly scalable applications and solving complex challenges.
• Optimizing performance in applications for maximum speed and scalability.

What Will you need to success?
• 3+ professional developer experience or equivalent.
• Solid software engineering experience, including issue tracking, source code management, code reviews, and testing frameworks.
• A great understanding of the JavaScript ecosystem (for example... React, jQuery, Angular, TypeScript).
• Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints.
• The ideal candidate has curiosity and experience in backend systems as well so that you can understand and contribute to it in support of your frontend responsibilities.
• Clear verbal and written communication; demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and with peers from a variety of disciplines.
• Good understanding of Agile development methodology and techniques.
• Fluent in English.

Why would you work with us?

We are committed to keep a healthy environment for our employees, where they will feel motivated, creative, and focused.

Benefits

We've designed our benefits and staffing programs keeping on mind all those features. Therefore, we are an organization it has been worried to create a great place to work, where you might be part of us. Here, you can find some of our benefits:
• Flexible Work Schedule.
• Mentoring & Coaching.
• Team based strategic planning.
• Remote Work Program.
• Multicultural environment.
• Flexible Compensation.
• Home Office Staff.

About Us

At Excibit Solutions Spain we are experts in technology and believe in its power to support our clients to reach their accomplishment, fostering excellence and increasing positive impact policy within the consultancy market. All based in our cornerstones: commitment, excellence, ethics and honesty

jobs_results.title: Front-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We are Netcompany-Intrasoft, a leading European IT Solutions and Services Group with strong international presence and expertise, offering innovative and added-value solutions of the highest quality to a wide range of international and national public and private organizations. More than 500 organizations in over 70 countries worldwide have chosen the company's services and solutions to fulfill their business needs.

For more information regarding our company, current projects, and openings around Europe, please consult our website: www.netcompany-intrasoft.com.

Job Description

We are looking for an inspired Developers to be members of high performing, Agile team responsible for developing amazing UIs used by millions of users in the EU. The role requires strong frontend development skills and good knowledge of relevant technologies.

We’re on the cutting edge of technology delivering IT Solutions for challenging, large-scale projects.

Qualifications

You... have...
• University degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
• 5+ years of Typescript experience
• 3+ year of React development experience, or some other relevant framework (Backbone.js, angularJS, vueJS)
• Knowledge of the interaction between JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
• Ability to create, modify, and style elements on a page with ease and can also do this dynamically
• Ability to analyse visual designs into design patterns
• Strong knowledge in MVC Architecture
• Knowledge of version control software
• Experience consuming RESTful API’s
• Good command of the English Language (written & verbal)

You May Have (one Or More)
• Cross browser experience, working with backwards compatibility with graceful degradation
• Experience in Bootstrap and responsive web application development
• Familiarity with backend development, understanding application layers
• Experience writing RESTful API’s and fully understanding the RESTful architecture and goals
• A background in design or appreciation of good design and UX
• Experience with SQL and being comfortable with querying databases

You are...
• Able to take ownership, accountability and initiative
• Detail-driven, able to take constructive criticism
• Strong analytical-thinker and problem-solver
• Communicative and team player

You will get…
• Competitive compensation package
• Continuous learning (with the most modern methods), and fast career growth
• Interesting and challenging work within large-scale projects
• International dynamic, fast-paced working environment
• Opportunity to work in a diverse environment with talented colleagues

Additional Information

We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. At Netcompany-Intrasoft we respect human rights as part of our culture, and we focus on creating a positive workplace in which all employees are valued and where diversity and inclusivity are welcomed.

Our culture

Our people are the most important element of our success. Our work life is well defined by our set of fundamental Values: https://bit.ly/3SSbBzU

#BePartOfSomethingGreat!
• Please submit your CV in English

All applications will be treated as strictly confidential

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect is an established company with a start-up culture seeking creative entrepreneurial people like you to join our team. We’re hiring a Frontend Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

You will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation over 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:
• Implement defined features through code development, while also conducting thorough... investigations and resolution of bugs
• Develop modular, reusable code components to streamline development and maintenance
• Utilize front-end frameworks like Vue.js, or Angular to create scalable and reusable UI components
• Optimize code and assets to ensure optimal load times and smooth performance
• Perform code reviews to uphold quality standards
• Collaborate within cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that either adhere to existing standards or establish new ones across departments
• Within an agile framework, you'll manage internal and external implementation requirements and expectations through clear communication and effective oversight
• Provide constructive feedback to the technical staff during all phases of the software lifecycle to keep development priorities aligned with business needs
• Take ownership and drive end-to-end quality software development processes

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):
• ~2–4 years of software development experience
• Proficiency in JavaScript
• Proven experience working with frontend frameworks such as Vue.js/React/Angular (or similar) and related tools and libraries
• Ability to take complex designs from Figma and convert to corresponding HTML/CSS/JS code
• Experience/knowledge of Agile methodologies like SCRUM/Kanban
• Knowledge of SOLID principles
• Knowledge of clean code practices
• Ability to work with complex enterprise software architectures
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment

Why you should join us? Let's see:
• 💰 Competitive salary in line with your experience and knowledge.
• 😏 You will work in a dynamic, well-functioning software development division with the world's largest provider of language services and technology solutions.
• 📈 Significant room for growth.
• 🎂 Enjoy a free day for your birthday.
• 🏝 22 days of paid vacations.
• 🥗 Ticket Restaurant.

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

Work model:

This position is intended to be largely in-office with a focus on flexibility. Today, most of the global team is on a hybrid model ranging between 3-4 days in the office per week. We aim to find an inclusive balance between everyone's personal lives and responsibilities and the value created from in-office collaboration. We work with new team members to find that balance with them while building the trust and collaboration that our team values.

We believe that sharing the same physical space with our colleagues creates a level of trust and understanding that fosters innovation and a sense of purpose.

The socializing and relationships formed from these in-person interactions have created the bonds that make our team successful.

We not only want to encourage people to safely spend time in the office, but also, schedule regular travel between our offices in Europe and the US – and a regular conference where the entire worldwide team is gathered together. Maybe the Metaverse will replace the office some day – but it hasn't yet! Online meetings were a powerful connector during the pandemic – but they don't foster the same connection

jobs_results.description:
En Sener apostamos fuertemente por la digitalización, es por ello que siempre estamos en búsqueda de los mejores profesional en esta área, siendo nuestro objetivo dar respuesta a las demandas de los proyectos que abordamos, en los ámbitos en los que, aportamos un gran expertis en ingeniería.

Desde el equipo de capacidades digitales, asumimos los nuevos retos de la organización, siempre empleando nuevas tecnologías, que permitan aportar un elemento diferenciador, con una visión de futuro.

¡Es el momento de unirte a nuestro reto!

Los conocimientos que tiene que aportar la persona que se una al equipo han de ser los siguientes:
• Conocimientos en programación
• Desarrollo software
• Experiencia en interface grafica y metodologías agile.
• Se valorará experiencia en UX

En cuanto a los softwares, trabajamos con:
• Javacript y frameworks como Angular
• Herramientas específicas de desarrollo como Git para control de vesriones
• Software de test
• Azure o similar

Pensamos en una persona... con Formación profesional de Grado Superior, que aporte más de 5 años de experiencia.

¿Cuál son nuestros beneficios?
• Contarás con políticas de flexibilidad horaria y trabajo en remoto.
• Tendrás acceso a un plan de compensación flexible.
• Te damos la oportunidad de disfrutar de un programa de bienestar físico y emocional.
• Nuestro compromiso es darte una estabilidad laboral y proyectos de larga duración.
• A través de las herramientas y un amplio abanico formativo podrás avanzar en tu desarrollo profesional.
• Trabajarás en un ambiente colaborativo, donde la estrecha relación dentro de las diferentes disciplinas facilita el intercambio de ideas, la proactividad y la autonomía para desenvolverse en equipos de proyectos complejos.
• Promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades, diversidad e inclusión de todas las personas y estamos certificados como Entidad Familiarmente Responsable (efr).

¿Por qué trabajar con Nosotros? En Sener, te ofrecemos la oportunidad de desarrollar y utilizar tus habilidades técnicas en una Ingeniería familiar internacional puntera y disfrutar de múltiples experiencias profesionales. ¿Quieres conocernos? https://www.group.sener/es

jobs_results.title: Remote Frontend Developer (EU Only)
jobs_results.description:
This is a remote position.

Are you a talented and experienced Frontend Developer looking for an exciting opportunity to work remotely? Join our Frontend Team for a startup based in the US, where you will have the chance to develop dashboards, charts and maps used by Fortune 500 companies. With a best-in-class codebase and a collaborative team, you'll contribute to cutting-edge projects that drive innovation.

Why Join Us:
• Remote work: Enjoy the flexibility and freedom of working remotely, allowing you to achieve a better work-life balance.
• Impactful projects: Collaborate with Fortune 500 companies, creating visually appealing charts and maps that make a difference in their decision-making processes.
• Talented team: Work alongside a highly skilled and supportive team, learning from each other and fostering professional growth.
• Global collaboration: Our team is distributed, with some members based in the US. We operate from 12 PM to 8 PM Central European Time zone, allowing for... convenient coordination and collaboration.

Responsibilities:
• Engage in regular meetings with the product manager to ensure alignment and contribute to project success.
• Design and develop frontend applications, leveraging your expertise in React, Next.js and TypeScript.
• Collaborate effectively with backend developers, fostering seamless integration and efficient project execution.
• Conduct thorough peer code reviews, ensuring high-quality code standards and identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Troubleshoot existing code, making necessary refinements and enhancements.

Requirements
• Fluency in English to communicate effectively and collaborate with the team.
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in frontend development.
• Proficiency in TypeScript, Next.js and React showcasing your ability to build robust and scalable applications.
• Strong knowledge of CSS, enabling you to create visually appealing user interfaces.
• Proficient with Git, demonstrating your expertise in version control.
• Experience with CSS-in-JS, allowing for efficient styling and component encapsulation.
• Familiarity with charting libraries, showcasing your ability to create engaging and interactive data visualizations.
• Solid understanding of JavaScript, enabling you to implement functionality and enhance user experience.
• Mandatory experience with Tailwind CSS, utilizing its powerful utility classes and streamlined workflow for responsive designs.

If you are a talented Frontend Developer seeking an exciting opportunity to work remotely with an innovative startup, please submit your application, including your resume, portfolio, and any relevant code samples. Only applicants located in the EU will be considered.

Note: This job posting is valid as of the date mentioned above and may be subject to change in the future

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
About Us

At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities.

JOIN THE TEAM

The product team “OT Cloud Services” develops cutting-edge cloud solutions for digitalization of production and operational technology in BASF. As an expert consulting team, we support BASF operating divisions and other IT teams to utilize cloud technologies and edge computing across various interesting and demanding projects like AI based plant control, predictive maintenance or asset and condition monitoring.

In this role, you will ensure scalable and reliable... operations of systems on both cloud and edge using container orchestration and infrastructure automation.

Responsibilities
• System administration of Linux-based systems, administration, and basic operations of Kubernetes clusters both on-premises and in the cloud
• Developing responsive and intuitive frontends applications (web apps and SPA) using modern frameworks (React preferred, other frameworks to be discussed)
• Aligning and formalizing application user experience (UX) requirements with application end users
• Aligning missing backend functionality with backend developers
• Ensuring continuous frontend availability and performance
• In certain cases: ensuring apps support multiple platforms, e.g. desktop/mobile

Qualifications
• Education

Degree in computer science, informatics, engineering, physics or in a comparable field

Internal
• Work Experience

Minimum 3 Years Of Related Working Experience
• Technical & Professional Knowledge
• Working in agile environments
• Fluent English
• Experience in industrial production and operational technology is a plus
• Strong drive to acquire new skills and learn about new technologies

Benefits
• A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority.
• Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life.
• Learning and development opportunities
• 23 holiday days per year
• 5 additional days (readjustment)
• 2 cultural days
• A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment
• Being part of an international team and work in global projects
• Relocation assistance to Madrid provided

At BASF, the chemistry is right.

At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer - Angular
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel con Amaris Consulting como Senior IOS Developer en España. Forma parte de un equipo internacional, prospera en un grupo global con una facturación de 800M€ y más de 1.000 clientes en todo el mundo, y un entorno ágil mediante. El candidato ideal deberá ser capaz de trabajar eficientemente en el entorno de desarrollo utilizando Visual Studio Code, Git, npm y Node.js. Además, se espera que tenga experiencia en la definición y ejecución de pruebas unitarias utilizando Jasmine y Karma.Únete a Amaris Consulting, donde podrás desarrollar tu potencial y marcar la diferencia dentro de la empresa.

✍️¿QUÉ NECESITARÍAS?✍️
• + 4 años de experiencia.
• Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Angular, preferiblemente en la versión 10.
• Fuerte conocimiento de TypeScript, CSS/SASS, Bootstrap y HTML5.
• Experiencia en el uso de IDE Visual Studio Code, control de versiones Git, gestión de paquetes npm y entorno de ejecución Node.js.
• Capacidad para... escribir pruebas unitarias efectivas utilizando Jasmine y Karma.
• Experiencia previa en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web responsivas y compatibles con múltiples navegadores.
• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente o en equipo.

🙌Y SI ADEMÁS…🙌
• Titulación en Informática, Ingeniería de Software o campo relacionado, será una ventaja.

👉¿QUÉ VAS A HACER?👈
• Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web utilizando Angular 10.
• Implementar interfaces de usuario atractivas y funcionales utilizando HTML5, CSS/SASS y Bootstrap.
• Colaborar con el equipo de diseño para convertir diseños en productos digitales interactivos.
• Integrar servicios back-end con APIs RESTful.
• Escribir código limpio y modular utilizando TypeScript.
• Realizar pruebas unitarias utilizando Jasmine y Karma para garantizar la calidad del código.
• Optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones para una carga rápida y una experiencia de usuario fluida.

🚀¿POR QUÉ NOSOTROS?🚀

Únete a nuestro equipo dinámico de personas talentosas y descubre un mundo lleno de crecimiento y oportunidades. Esto es lo que ofrecemos:
• Crecimiento rápido a través de un camino profesional personalizado y evaluación salarial. El 70% de nuestros líderes senior comenzaron en puestos de nivel inicial.
• Mejora tus habilidades a través de nuestro catálogo de nuestra Academia Tecnológica, la plataforma Udemy, Clases de idiomas, webinars y talleres.
• Toma el control de tu formación conun presupuesto personal anual y certificaciones pagadas por la empresa.
• Disfruta de políticas flexibles, opciones de trabajo remoto y excelentes beneficios socialescomo boletos de transporte y restaurantes, apoyo para guardería y seguro de salud privado.
• Benefíciate denuestro programa WeCare, que brindaapoyo a los empleados en situaciones críticas.
• Libera todo tu potencial, tanto profesional como personal.

Amaris Consulting se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Nos comprometemos a promover la diversidad dentro de la plantilla y a crear un entorno de trabajo inclusivo. Para ello, damos la bienvenida a las solicitudes de todos los candidatos cualificados, independientemente de su género, orientación sexual, raza, etnia, creencias, edad, estado civil, discapacidad u otras características

jobs_results.title: Angular Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
¿Estás en proceso de búsqueda de un cambio? ¿Te interesan los nuevos retos?

¡Esta es tu oportunidad, queremos conocerte!

En Vermont Solutions estamos ampliando nuestro equipo, por eso buscamos un profesional que quiera crecer con nosotros, trabajando como Angular Frontend Developer en un proyecto del sector bancario y 100% en remoto.

El desarrollo del proyecto requerirá tener una experiencia de al menos 3-4 años y haber realizado proyectos desde cero.

Las habilidades y conocimientos necesarios serán:
• Experiencia avanzada en Angular, incluyendo la capacidad de configurar un proyecto desde cero, manejar el archivo angular.json para entornos de desarrollo y producción, configurar el proxy, entre otros.
• Dominio de versiones de librerías con npm, incluyendo la capacidad de identificar la versión específica instalada a partir del package-lock y solucionar errores críticos de dependencias.
• Conocimiento avanzado de Typescript.
• Experiencia en el uso de Git, incluyendo la gestión de... ramas, pull requests, merge, rebase, cherry pick, reset, entre otros.
• Experiencia en pruebas unitarias con Karma o Jest.
• Familiaridad con Jenkins para despliegues y configuración de pipelines.
• Conocimientos básicos de OpenShift para ver versiones desplegadas y realizar rollbacks.
• Comprensión de la arquitectura de Shell y Microfrontends, así como del Module Federation de Angular.
• Experiencia en Webcomponents, incluyendo su creación e integración.
• Conocimiento de configuración de webpack.
• Familiaridad con errores de CORS y reglas de CSP.

Será muy valorable en tu candidatura tener experiencia con:
• React
• Conocimientos Backend.
• Arquitectura Hexagonal.
• Conocer nginx y saber consultar y crear reglas y redirecciones
• Buena capacidad de investigación tanto de posibles errores como de implementación de nuevas tecnologías.

Idiomas: el nivel de Inglés será mínimo un B2, y muy deseable un C1.

Ofrecemos:
• Plan de Formación y certificaciones técnicas.
• Desarrollo profesional y plan de carrera definido.
• Flexibilidad horaria
• Plan de retribución flexible acorde a tus necesidades (seguro médico privado, cheques formación para estudiar idiomas, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte...).
• Integración en un equipo de profesionales motivados, en un ambiente de trabajo innovador y dinámico.
• Modelo de gestión sostenible y políticas de igualdad efectiva, ambientes de trabajo abiertos e inclusivos
